description: Checkpoints required by the six structure-based generation models orchestrated by prism.generation. The bytes are NOT part of a PRISM install; this manifest records where each artifact belongs, how big it is, what its SHA256 must be, and whether PRISM is permitted to mirror it.
layout: Paths are relative to $PRISM_MODELS_DIR (default $XDG_CACHE_HOME/prism/models, else ~/.cache/prism/models). The tree deliberately mirrors the upstream release layout and the cluster deployment layout (<models_dir>/<model>/...), so an existing prism-models directory can be used by pointing PRISM_MODELS_DIR at it without moving a single file.

mirror.note: Set to the release download base URL of the PRISM weights repository once it exists; artifacts are fetched from <base_url>/<mirror_asset>. Override at runtime with PRISM_MODELS_MIRROR, which also accepts a file:// URL for offline clusters. Only artifacts with redistributable=true may ever be given a mirror_asset.

targetdiff.title: TargetDiff
targetdiff.upstream_instructions: Follow the 'Pretrained models' section of the upstream README and save pretrained_diffusion.pt at the path above. The upstream checkout carries no LICENSE file, so PRISM does not mirror this checkpoint.

pocket2mol.title: Pocket2Mol
pocket2mol.upstream_instructions: Download the pretrained checkpoint linked from the upstream README and save pretrained_Pocket2Mol.pt at the path above. The upstream checkout carries no LICENSE file, so PRISM does not mirror this checkpoint.

pocketxmol.title: PocketXMol
pocketxmol.attribution: PocketXMol model release, Zenodo record 17801271, version 1.0.0, licensed CC BY 4.0.
pocketxmol.upstream_instructions: Zenodo record 17801271; unpack so that data/trained_models/pxm/ lands under <models_dir>/pocketxmol/weights/.

molcraft.title: MolCRAFT
molcraft.attribution: MolCRAFT checkpoint by the MolCRAFT authors, licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. NonCommercial use only; derivative weights must be shared under the same licence.
molcraft.upstream_instructions: Follow the checkpoint link in the upstream README and save molcraft.ckpt at the path above.

flowr.title: FLOWR
flowr.upstream_instructions: Zenodo record 15737419; save flowr_noHs.ckpt at the path above. The upstream README states MIT but the pinned checkout ships no LICENSE file and the Zenodo record carries no machine-readable licence, so PRISM does not mirror this checkpoint.

diffsbdd.title: DiffSBDD
diffsbdd.upstream_instructions: Download crossdocked_fullatom_cond.ckpt from the upstream release and save it at the path above. The checkout used for integration was copied without its .git directory, so no source commit is pinned yet; pin one before regenerating. The checkout carries no LICENSE file, so PRISM does not mirror this checkpoint.
